title: Ikigeragezo c'Ikiremwa Ceranda
intro: Ikimenyetso cararungikiwe ihanga ryari ryazimiye. Hagati mu buzima bwabo bwiza, haraje imburi—iherekejwe n’ikiremwa kidasanzwe cari kuba ikigeragezo nyamukuru c’ukwizera kwabo. Inyishu yabo yobaye ikidodo ku bijanye n’iherezo ryabo ibihe bidahera. Woba ushobora guhishura uwatanze iyo ngabisho be n’ivyo vyashikiye abayanse?
clues: Twari abantu bari bayobowe n’intumwa zabanje imbere yacu.
Ikiremwa giteye igomwe cavuye ku musozi, ikimenyetso kivuye ku Mukama wacu kuri iri hanga.
Nanje ndababwira nti: «Iyi ni ingamiya y’ingore ya Allah, rero muyireke irye ivy’isi ya Allah, ntimuyikoreko nabi.»
Ariko abantu baciye ingamiya yanje y’ingore, baciye ku ruhande itegeko ry’Umukama wabo.
Ndi intumwa gusa ivuye ku Mukama wawe, yarungitswe n’ukuri—ndi umuhanuzi n’umusuku wo kwizigirwa.
Nayo inkozi z’ikibi, Umukama wacu yarabakubise ijwi ry’inkuba, bacika abatagira aho bava mu ngo zabo.

identity.label: Jewe ndi nde?
options: Umuhanuzi Hudi wo mu bantu b'i A'adi .
Umuhanuzi Salih wo mu bantu ba Thamud .
Umuhanuzi Luti wo mu bantu b’i Sodomu .
identity.answer: Umuhanuzi Salih wo mu bantu ba Thamud .

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
